Class Intrinsic

java.lang.Object
org.cobol4j.Intrinsic
public final class Intrinsic extends Object
COBOL intrinsic functions.

These map to COBOL's FUNCTION keyword: 

// COBOL:  MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-DATE
// Java:   rec.move("WS-DATE", Intrinsic.currentDate());

// COBOL:  COMPUTE LEN = FUNCTION LENGTH(WS-NAME)
// Java:   rec.compute("LEN", Intrinsic.length(rec, "WS-NAME"));

// COBOL:  MOVE FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(WS-NAME) TO WS-UPPER
// Java:   rec.move("WS-UPPER", Intrinsic.upperCase(rec.getString("WS-NAME")));

    • currentDate

      public static String currentDate()
      FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE — returns 21-character date-time string. Format: YYYYMMDDHHMMSSss+HHMM (year, month, day, hour, min, sec, hundredths of second, timezone offset).

    • whenCompiled

      public static String whenCompiled()
      FUNCTION WHEN-COMPILED — returns the compilation timestamp. In transpiled code this would be set at build time; here we return the current time as a placeholder.
